name: Pod retention — nightly per-kind sweep
notes: Applies each pod kind's registry retention policy (configs/pod_kinds.json `retention`): keep_days kinds lose pods older than the cutoff, keep_latest newest survive regardless of age, pods with projection rows (secrets) are never swept. Keeps the store bounded under the query layer's scan ceiling (2026-07-08 pod audit R4). Runs after the 04:00-04:30 subconscious lanes, before the day's minting.
